# Metaplate v0.8.0

Metaplate 0.8 is the largest release so far. Plates now render on Deno-based edge runtimes, write and verify static files from one command, cache their renders, and guard against blank or broken cards. Metadata gains page tags, X player and app cards, Open Graph video and audio, JSON-LD, Adaptive Cards, versioned and signed image URLs, and a live preview. `metaplate verify-page` audits a deployed page the way crawlers read it. Hosted deployments on Vercel, Netlify, and Deno Deploy are certified for the first time.

No export is removed and every 0.7 plate keeps rendering, but a few checks are stricter (see [Breaking changes](#breaking-changes)).

> **Upgrade recommendation:** Recommended for every 0.7 user. Read the behavior changes below if you rely on `socialImageCompatibility` results for `discord` or `x`, on font loaders accepting unusual bytes, or on raw characters in relative image paths.

## Why upgrade

- **Run where your site runs.** `metaplate/edge` renders through `@resvg/resvg-wasm` on Deno-based edges (hosted-certified on Netlify Edge Functions and Deno Deploy). The `satori` peer range widens from `>=0.33.3 <0.34` to `>=0.33.3 <1`, so a current Satori no longer conflicts.
- **Ship static cards safely.** `metaplate render` writes every page and size, verifies each file on disk, and records a manifest that a failed run never leaves stale.
- **Catch broken cards before crawlers do.**
  - Render guards fail a card with overflowing text, missing glyphs, or a single color.
  - `verify-page` audits a deployed page's tags, images, and robots.txt access for each platform.
  - The compatibility profiles now encode Discord's and X's documented image rules.
- **Describe everything platforms read:**
  - page-level Open Graph and `article:` tags;
  - X player and app cards;
  - Open Graph video and audio;
  - Schema.org JSON-LD;
  - Teams Adaptive Cards.

## Highlights

### Rendering

- **Edge runtimes.** `metaplate/edge` (new entry) renders PNG through `@resvg/resvg-wasm` and Satori's standalone build.
  - The caller supplies both Wasm modules.
  - It is hosted-certified on Netlify Edge Functions and Deno Deploy.
  - Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge forbid compiling Wasm at run time and are not supported.
  - See [Edge runtimes](https://github.com/lnorton89/metaplate/blob/v0.8.0/docs/edge.md).
- **Render guards** (`guards: { overflow, missingGlyphs, blank }`) report or fail a render whose text leaves the canvas, whose text no font covers, or whose image is a single color. `RenderGuardError` names the problem.
- **Render caching.**
  - `plate.cached()` renders each distinct copy once. It serves strong ETags with 304/412 handling, through a bounded LRU or your own store.
  - `metaplate render --incremental` reuses files whose inputs and bytes are unchanged.
- **Images and assets.**
  - Plate components may be `async`.
  - `imageAsset` and `imageAssetLoader` embed checked image bytes.
  - The new `metaplate/assets` entry reads project files and allowlisted remote images.
- **Emoji** render as images from an installed set (`packageEmojiLoader`) or from bytes you serve (`metaplate/emoji`, a new entry).
- **Other scripts.** `languageFonts` renders Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, and more from installed Fontsource packages, offline. Before, that text drew missing-glyph boxes.
- **Size variants.** One plate can declare square and landscape sizes, with per-size paths, alt text, and metadata.

### Static files and preview

- **`metaplate render <module>`** renders every page and size of a render module into `--out`. It verifies each file's hash, format, and dimensions as read back from disk, and writes `metaplate-manifest.json` atomically.
  - A failing run removes the old manifest.
  - A file whose extension would make a static host serve the wrong type is refused.
  - See [Render CLI](https://github.com/lnorton89/metaplate/blob/v0.8.0/docs/render-cli.md).
- **`metaplate preview <module>`** serves a live local gallery: every page and size, with its metadata, verification results, Satori debug boxes, and crop overlays. It reloads when the module changes.

### Metadata and URLs

- **Page tags.** `socialMetaTags` and `socialMetaHtml` serialize validated page-level fields (title, description, URL, locale, `article:` times and tags, `theme-color`). `metaplate/next` maps them to Next's `Metadata` and `Viewport`.
- **X player and app cards**, **Open Graph video and audio**, **Schema.org JSON-LD** (`socialImageJsonLd`), and **Teams Adaptive Cards** (`socialImageAdaptiveCard`).
- **Versioned image URLs.** `version: "copy"` adds a content-derived `?v=` token so crawlers refetch a changed card. `revision` covers changes the copy can't show.
- **Signed image routes.** `signImagePath` and `verifyImageSignature` (HMAC-SHA-256 via Web Crypto, with secret rotation) stop anyone else from rendering arbitrary copy on your route.

### Image and page checks

- **`metaplate verify-url`** fetches a deployed image through a hardened fetcher and runs the same checks as `verify`. The fetcher:
  - blocks private addresses and pins DNS;
  - checks redirects, byte limits, and timeouts;
  - decodes gzip, deflate, and br bodies.
- **`metaplate verify-page`** audits a deployed page:
  - It reads the page's social tags with a parser that follows the HTML spec closely.
  - It verifies every image the page names.
  - It checks each platform crawler's robots.txt access (RFC 9309).
  - It warns when tags sit past a crawler's read limit.
- **Compatibility profiles.**
  - New targets: `teams`, `whatsapp`, `bluesky`, `telegram`, `threads`, and `pinterest`.
  - `discord` and `x` now check those platforms' documented image rules.
  - `--require-content` fails a blank PNG.

### Deployment evidence

- **Hosted certifications, all dated 2026-11-01:**
  - Vercel Functions (Node.js runtime);
  - Next.js 16.4.3 on Vercel;
  - Netlify Functions and Netlify Edge Functions;
  - Deno Deploy (both renderers);
  - Bun and Deno runtime smokes of the packed tarball, now required CI checks.
- **Local packed-artifact fixtures:**
  - Next.js static export and `next start`;
  - Astro static and `@astrojs/node` server;
  - React Router 8 resource routes;
  - SvelteKit 3 `+server` routes;
  - Express;
  - an edge consumer.
- See [Framework and runtime support](https://github.com/lnorton89/metaplate/blob/v0.8.0/docs/support.md) and [Deployment](https://github.com/lnorton89/metaplate/blob/v0.8.0/docs/deployment.md).

### Fixes

- `metaplate/next` now imports `next/og.js`, so it works in plain Node (scripts and test runners that don't bundle) and under NodeNext types.
- An SVG with a fractional size no longer fails `verifySocialImage` and `verify-page`.
- A trailing `--size` or `--format` that no file follows is an error instead of being ignored.
- `metaplate <command> --help` succeeds.

## Breaking changes

No export is removed and no signature narrows. These behavior changes can alter the results of existing calls:

- **Font loaders reject non-font bytes.** Every loader throws a `TypeError` for bytes that are not TrueType, OpenType, WOFF, or WOFF2, where Satori used to render the text as nothing. A failed font fetch (an HTML error page, an empty body) now fails the render instead of caching a blank card.
- **`discord` checks formats.** It now requires PNG, GIF, JPEG, WebP, or AVIF instead of reporting an unknown contract.
- **`x` checks X's Card image rules.** It now requires JPG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF (SVG fails), under 5MB, 144x144 to 4096x4096 pixels, and alt text of at most 420 characters. Before, it checked only the URL and alt text.
- **Relative image paths are percent-encoded.** `socialImagePath` without an `origin` now encodes spaces, control characters, and non-ASCII, exactly as the absolute URL always did. A route such as `/a b` now yields `/a%20b/og-image`.

Upgrade advice: run your existing `socialImageCompatibility` and `metaplate verify --target` checks once after upgrading. If `x` now fails an SVG card, render PNG or JPEG for it.

## Install or upgrade

```sh
npm install metaplate@0.8.0
```

That single command still includes the framework-neutral SVG and PNG renderer: npm 7+ and pnpm 8+ install the `satori`, `@resvg/resvg-js`, and `react` peers. Yarn needs them added explicitly. Node.js 20 or newer is required.

Peer changes:

- `satori` widens to `>=0.33.3 <1`. The audited release is 0.63.2; `metaplate/edge` needs 0.35.2 or newer. To move an existing project to the audited line, run `npm install satori@0.63`.
- `@resvg/resvg-wasm` (`>=2.6.2 <3`) is a new optional peer, needed only by `metaplate/edge`: `npm install @resvg/resvg-wasm`.
- `next` (`>=16.3.2 <17`) stays optional and is still supplied by Next applications.

New entry points: `metaplate/edge`, `metaplate/emoji`, and `metaplate/assets`.

## Verification

- `npm run check` passes:
  - lint;
  - a zero-tolerance duplication scan;
  - workflow pin policy;
  - dependency inventory and Socket disposition policy;
  - deployment evidence policy;
  - release-note validation;
  - source and example type checks;
  - 1,286 tests;
  - build;
  - the package dry run.
- `npm run check:package` installs the exact local tarball into clean consumers. It then builds, serves, and fetches images from every fixture listed above, and runs `metaplate/next` in plain Node.
- `npm run release:evidence` re-runs the build, packed-artifact, inventory, deployment, Socket, and workflow checks, records each result with its output, and binds the bundle, including every artifact's SHA-256, to the release commit.
- **Hosted certifications.** These ran on 2026-11-01 from pre-release 0.8.0 tarballs, packed at commits 4135f77 (Vercel), 4b04f90 and 697f6f7 (Netlify), and 36be0e9 (Deno Deploy). Each recorded:
  - status, media type, and dimensions;
  - response headers;
  - distinct bytes per slug;
  - a decoded check that each image is not blank.

  Raw outputs are in [`.planning/hosted-evidence/`](https://github.com/lnorton89/metaplate/tree/v0.8.0/.planning/hosted-evidence). Changes made after those dates are covered by the packed-artifact fixtures and the Bun and Deno smokes, which run on every commit, not by new hosted deployments.
- **Socket baseline.** It is the Socket CLI deep score of the published `metaplate@0.7.0`, captured 2026-10-31. The package itself scores 80 overall with no alerts. Its two high dependency alerts carry time-bounded dispositions that expire 2027-04-30:
  - `string.prototype.codepointat`, under the Satori peer;
  - `tslib@2.9.1`'s ownership change, reached only through the optional `next` peer.

  Socket scores only published packages, so 0.8.0 is scored after publication. `npm audit` is not a substitute for Socket's behavioral analysis.
- **Dependabot alert #68** (deepmerge prototype poisoning, no patched release) is dismissed as tolerable risk. deepmerge is reached only through `@sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte`, a development dependency of the SvelteKit fixture, where it merges the fixture's own configuration. It is not in the published package or its peers.
- npm registry signature and SLSA provenance verification run after publication, against the published artifact.
